verdict.summary: You can create an app and connect your own account without review. Installs are capped at 25 accounts until a hand-reviewed Marketplace listing is approved.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 1-2 hours for a working app; several days to weeks for listing prep
verdict.approval_wait: None for up to 25 installs; Marketplace listing: initial review within 10 business days, feedback cycles up to 60 days

gates.name: Developer app (own account)
gates.unlocks: Create an app and install it in your own or test accounts.
limits: Developer test accounts are excluded from install counts
Installing user must be a Super Admin or have Marketplace Access permission

gates.name: Unlisted Marketplace / privately distributed app
gates.unlocks: Install by other customers without listing review, within caps.
limits: Private OAuth app: 10 allowlisted accounts, up to 100 if created in a Solutions Partner portal
Cap enforced from 22 Sept 2025; legacy apps above 25 are capped on migration
Access tokens are short-lived; use the refresh token
Possible unverified-app warning on consent screen (third-party report)

gates.name: Marketplace listing (and optional certification)
gates.unlocks: Unlimited installs for a listed Marketplace OAuth app; certification is a higher tier.
limits: Only one app can be in listing review at a time
Certification needs 60+ installs, a security assessment, and a demo video
gates.time_to_reach: Weeks; certification needs 6+ months of listing

steps.title: Decide managed vs own app
steps.detail: Composio's managed HubSpot app works immediately but requests a broad scope list. Register your own app if you need your own redirect URI, trimmed scopes, a Marketplace listing, or control over install caps.

steps.title: Get a HubSpot developer account
steps.detail: Sign up or log in at the developer portal. Create a developer test account to install into.

steps.title: Create the app with the CLI
steps.detail: Run hs project create. Choose Marketplace or private distribution, and OAuth authentication.
gotchas: Distribution type determines your install cap

steps.title: Set redirect URI and scopes
steps.detail: In app-hsmeta.json, set redirectUrls to the Composio callback URL and list only the scopes you use in requiredScopes, optionalScopes or conditionallyRequiredScopes. Push with hs project upload.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: Must be https in production and a domain, not an IP
Put scopes only some customers have in optional lists

steps.title: Copy client ID and secret into Composio
steps.detail: Copy them from the app's Auth page and add them to a Composio auth config for the hubspot toolkit.

steps.title: Connect your own account
steps.detail: Run the authorization flow as a Super Admin. If it fails, check Development > Monitoring > Logs, OAuth tab.
gotchas: Install fails if the installer lacks access to any required scope

steps.title: Invite other accounts within caps
steps.detail: Install in up to 25 accounts (unlisted Marketplace) or allowlist up to 10 (private). Verify your company domain to reduce the unverified-app warning.

steps.title: Prepare listing materials
steps.detail: Draft live Terms of Service and Privacy Policy URLs, support contact, setup docs, and a Shared data table matching your scopes. Make OAuth the only auth method and remove classic CRM cards. Accept the Technology Partner Program Agreement.
gotchas: Incomplete listings are set to Draft
AI connectors need user-level permissions or HubSpot's MCP server
Apps with app cards cannot use sensitive data scopes

steps.title: Get 3 active installs and submit for listing
steps.detail: You need at least three active unique unaffiliated production installs in the past 30 days. Submit one app only.

steps.title: Wait for Ecosystem Quality review
steps.detail: Initial review takes within 10 business days. Feedback cycles run up to 60 days.

steps.title: Optional: apply for certification
steps.detail: After 6 months listed and 60+ installs, pass the security assessment and questionnaire and submit a demo video showing the uninstall flow. Keep request errors under 5%.

requirements.item: Installer is a Super Admin or has Marketplace Access
requirements.detail: Required to install apps in a HubSpot account.

requirements.item: HTTPS redirect URI on a domain
requirements.detail: http is allowed only for localhost; must match the saved value.

requirements.item: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, support contact, setup docs
3+ active unique installs, OAuth only, minimal scopes
Certification: verified domain, security assessment, 60 installs

requirements.detail: Marketplace OAuth apps get 110 requests per 10 seconds per account (the certification page says 100).

scopes.effect: Standard scopes; request only what the app uses.
Marketplace apps must request access from the Ecosystem Quality team. Needs an Enterprise account, and is incompatible with app cards.
A separate, higher tier; needs an Enterprise subscription.
Admin-level scopes can block non-admin installers; omit them if unused.

blockers.symptom: Install error about an included scope
blockers.cause: The installing user or account lacks access to a required scope.
blockers.fix: Move the scope to optional or conditionally required, or have a Super Admin install.
Verify the company domain in HubSpot's Contact & support settings.

blockers.cause: Install cap for unlisted or private apps.
blockers.fix: Get a Marketplace listing approved, or create the private app in a Solutions Partner portal for up to 100.

blockers.cause: Only one app can be in review at a time.
blockers.fix: Wait for the first review to finish.

blockers.symptom: Unlisted app told to rebuild as an AI connector
blockers.cause: HubSpot special rules for AI connectors (community report).
blockers.fix: Use user-level permissions or HubSpot's MCP server.

composio.note: Start on managed auth to test quickly. Register your own app for your own redirect URI, trimmed scopes (Composio's defaults include settings.users.write and many write scopes), a Marketplace listing, or installs beyond the caps. Whether the managed app counts against HubSpot's install caps is undocumented. The list shown is abbreviated; Composio's full default list is longer.

evidence.claim: Composio offers managed OAuth for HubSpot with a broad default scope list.
evidence.quote: managed_oauth_available: true; authorization_url https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize

evidence.claim: Listing minimums include OAuth only, 3 active installs, agreement, minimal scopes.
evidence.quote: Installs: your app must have at least three active, unique installs.

evidence.claim: Listing needs live ToS and Privacy Policy URLs, support contact, setup docs, Shared data table.
evidence.quote: URLs for your app’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy must be live and up-to-date.

evidence.claim: Listing restrictions: no classic CRM cards; AI connectors need user-level permissions or MCP.
evidence.quote: if your app is an AI connector ... it must require user-level permissions

evidence.claim: Certification needs 6 months listed, 60 installs, verified domain, security assessment, questionnaire, demo video.
evidence.quote: Your app must have at least 60 active, unique installs to qualify for and retain certification.

evidence.claim: Certification review target is 10 business days; loop capped at 60 days; lasts two years.
evidence.quote: The HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team responds to app certification requests within 10 business days.

evidence.claim: Demo video must show disconnect and Uninstall App endpoint.
evidence.quote: Use the Uninstall App API Endpoint when removing the app from a customer's HubSpot account.

evidence.claim: Errors must stay under 5% of daily requests.
evidence.quote: Requests resulting in an error response shouldn’t exceed 5% of your total daily requests.

evidence.claim: Installers must be Super Admin or have Marketplace Access.
evidence.quote: Users installing apps in their HubSpot account must either be a Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace Access permissions.

evidence.claim: Install fails if installer lacks access to an included scope.
evidence.quote: users will get an error if they try to install your app in an account that doesn't have access to an included scope.

evidence.claim: Scopes set in app-hsmeta.json auth block and pushed with hs project upload.
evidence.quote: edit the corresponding scopes within the auth property of your app's app-hsmeta.json file locally, then run the hs project upload command

evidence.claim: Apps on Developer Platform 2025.2 are capped at 25 installs until listed on the Marketplace; enforced from 22 September 2025.
evidence.quote: capped at 25 installs until they are listed on the HubSpot Marketplace.

evidence.claim: Optional scopes are dropped for accounts lacking access.
evidence.quote: Optional scopes will be automatically dropped from the authorization request if the user selects a HubSpot account that doesn't have access to that tool

evidence.claim: Sensitive Data scopes must be requested from the Ecosystem Quality team for Marketplace apps.
evidence.quote: you’ll need to request access to specific sensitive scopes from HubSpot’s Ecosystem Quality team.

evidence.claim: Highly sensitive scopes are a separate tier; Enterprise subscription required.
evidence.quote: The HubSpot account must have an Enterprise subscription to access Sensitive Data functionality.

evidence.claim: Apps with app cards must not use sensitive data scopes.
evidence.quote: Your app must not access, request, or use sensitive data scopes.

evidence.claim: Create the app with hs project create, choosing distribution and auth type.
evidence.quote: select whether you plan to distribute your app on the HubSpot Marketplace or if want to restrict installation to specific HubSpot accounts.

evidence.claim: Redirect URIs must be https in production.
evidence.quote: this URL must use https in production. (When testing using localhost, http can be used.)

evidence.claim: Copy client ID and secret from the Auth page, then exchange code for tokens.
evidence.quote: Your app's client secret will be used in step 4 below

evidence.claim: Install attempts are visible in Development > Monitoring > Logs, OAuth tab.
evidence.quote: AUTHORIZATION_CODE_EXPIRY: an error that occurs when the auth code expired before the token was exchanged.

evidence.claim: Marketplace OAuth apps are limited to 110 requests per 10 seconds per account.
evidence.quote: each HubSpot account that installs your app is limited to 110 requests every 10 seconds.

evidence.claim: Developer portal loads with no login wall in probe.
evidence.quote: title: Developers | HubSpot; login_wall: false

evidence.claim: Install caps by distribution type: unlisted Marketplace 25, listed unlimited, private OAuth 10, static-token one; test accounts excluded.
evidence.quote: Marketplace OAuth app prior to listing: can be installed in up to 25 accounts (not including developer test accounts).

evidence.claim: Unverified apps show a warning; verifying company domain is the fix (third-party).
evidence.quote: To avoid the "unverified app" warning, make sure to verify your company domain in the Contact & support settings.

evidence.claim: Admin-only scope blocks non-admin users (user report).
evidence.quote: settings.users.teams.read is a super admin–only scope. Non-admin users can never approve it

evidence.claim: Community report of an unlisted app classified as an AI connector.
evidence.quote: At this time, we have special Marketplace requirements for AI connectors.

evidence.claim: Private OAuth apps reach 100 accounts when created in a Solutions Partner portal.
evidence.quote: up to 100 customer portals when the app is created in a Solutions Partner portal

evidence.claim: Legacy public apps above 25 installs get the cap enforced on migration.
evidence.quote: the install limit will be automatically enforced.

evidence.claim: Access tokens are short-lived with an expires_in value.
evidence.quote: When an access token is generated, it will include an expires_in parameter

evidence.claim: Older docs say access tokens expire after 30 minutes.
evidence.quote: This token is provided as a Bearer token in the request, and expires after 30 minutes.

evidence.claim: Listing submissions are reviewed by the Ecosystem Quality team, initial review within 10 business days.
evidence.quote: the HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team will complete an initial review within 10 business days.

evidence.claim: Only one app can be in listing review at a time.
evidence.quote: any additional apps submitted while the initial app is being processed will automatically be rejected.

open_questions: Whether a paid HubSpot subscription is needed to create a Developer Platform app was not confirmed.
Refresh token lifetime, rotation and PKCE support were not found.
Whether Composio's managed app counts against the 25/10 install caps is undocumented.
Click-by-click developer portal UI was not confirmed.
Company-domain verification steps for the consent screen were not confirmed from HubSpot pages.
Sensitive Data approval timelines and criteria are unknown.
Community reports on scope stickiness and AI-connector rules may be out of date.
